ally_customer: Hey team — multiple customers complaining about 5xx and long timeouts on hosted inference since ~09:10 UTC. Saw a bunch of `503` and `504` from /v1/generate, p95 jumping to >30s. Can we get quick triage? :frowning:
maria_support: Thanks for flagging, ally. Can you paste a couple of request IDs or tenant IDs? Any pattern (same tenant, model, prompt size)? :eyes:
ally_customer: Tenant: tenant-clarity, recent req_id: r12345-09:12, r12346-09:13. Models: rgl-7b, payloads often with long context (6–8k tokens). Happens intermittently but tail latency spikes.
kevin_sre: Seeing an alert too — ingress-monitor-bot reported queue depth saturation for the hosted gateway (queue_depth ~98% for batchers, continuous-batcher backlog increasing). 5xx spike matches. Likely continuous batching backlog -> evictions/timeouts.
ingress-monitor-bot: ALERT: host-gateway queue_depth=98.7% (3m avg), dequeue_rate down 40%, 504_rate=6.9% over last 5m, affected_tenant=tenant-clarity, impacted_pools=[hosted-us-west-1-pool-3].
nate_runtime: I've pulled runtime traces for r12345 and r12346 — both stuck in batch enqueue for ~22s before getting a deadline response. Stack shows `enqueue_timeout -> eviction -> gateway 504` from rpc_gateway->batcher_manager.
maria_support: Can you paste the small trace snippet? We need to share with customer so they have repro steps.
nate_runtime: ````
Trace r12345
  enqueue_start: 2026-03-09T09:12:11Z
  enqueue_wait: 22.4s
  batch_assign: failed (queue full)
  gateway_response: 504 deadline_exceeded
  model: rgl-7b, seq_len: 6200
````
kevin_sre: Hypothesis: a thundering-herd of long-context requests drove continuous batcher -> K/V cache warmup + large dynamic batches -> per-token compute time increased -> batcher backlog built up -> queue depth caps hit -> early eviction/timeouts. Also saw high KV cache misses in those traces.
maria_support: Repro attempt steps for internal debug and customer: 1) send many parallel requests with long prefix (~6k tokens) to /v1/generate 2) increase concurrency until 503/504 shows 3) capture gateway trace and X-Request-ID. Share curl example: ````
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"rgl-7b","input":"<6k-token-prefix> ...","max_tokens":64}' &
````
ally_customer: We can repro locally by ramping to ~120 concurrent long-prefix requests, latency rockets and some return 504.
kevin_sre: Short-term mitigations I pushed: 1) enabled proactive reject_nonessential for hosted-us-west-1-pool-3 (drops background/low-priority tenants) 2) rotated a subset of traffic for tenant-clarity to fallback smaller model (rgl-3b-quant) via canary route 3) increased dequeue threads on pool-3 by +2 (hotfix).
deploy-bot: deploy/route-change by kevin_sre succeeded (canary route -> rgl-3b-quant) at 2026-03-09T09:17:08Z.
kevin_sre: Early results: queue_depth dropped to ~72% in 45s, 504s fell to baseline ~0.6%. Customer-facing latency p95 reduced from 30s -> 6.2s.
maria_support: Customer notified and confirmed reduced errors. Sending follow-up with suggested best practices (reduce long-prefix concurrency, use prefix caching, opt for dedicated pool for high sustained throughput). :white_check_mark:
ally_customer: Thanks, team. Can we also get an RCA and long-term fix? This pattern could repeat during customer async migrations.
kevin_sre: Agreed — immediate next steps for RCA: - analyze batching histograms for sequence_length distribution - KV cache warmup behavior for large contexts - evaluate raising queue_depth cap vs smarter eviction policy - recommend model resource sizing/quantization for that tenant.
nate_runtime: I will capture a 10-minute flame + batching timeline and share. Plan to test: 1) simulate thundering-batcher with long-prefix requests in staging 2) try prefix K/V prefill + continuous-batcher tuning (max_batch_size, max_wait_ms) 3) test adaptive early-reject thresholds for tenant priority.
maria_support: I'll schedule a postmortem thread and sync with Customer Success on recommending Dedicated for tenant-clarity if they need sustained high concurrency.
kevin_sre: Leaving this thread open — closing incident if metrics stay stable for 1h. Will paste RCA link and PM notes here. :hammer_and_wrench:
